## Time Flayer (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
 NE Medium outsider (extraplanar, time)  

**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +21  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 28, touch 18, flat-footed 28 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 insight, +10 natural)  

**hp** 162 (13d10+32)  

**Fort** +9, **Ref** +12, **Will** +13  

**Defensive Abilities** foresight; **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** time  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  

**Melee** *+1 greatsword* +19/+14/+9 (2d6+7, 19-20/x2)  

**Special Attacks** temporal displacement, unmaking  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 19, **Dex** 15, **Con** 16, **Int** 20, **Wis** 20, **Cha** 19  

**Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +17; **CMD** 35  

**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (greatsword), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Toughness.*  

**Skills** Acrobatics +16, Bluff +20, Climb +10, Diplomacy +19, Escape Artist +16, Intimidate +20, Knowledge (history) +21, Knowledge (the planes) +21, Perception +21, Stealth +24, Sense Motive +21, Survival +21  

**Languages** Common plus any five  

**SQ** reality bend, time jaunt  

**Gear** *+1 greatsword*  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Foresight (Su)** A time flayer can see a few seconds into the future. This ability prevents a time flayer from being surprised, caught flat-footed, or flanked. It also grants the time flayer an insight bonus to AC equal to its Wisdom bonus. This ability can be negated, but the time flayer can restart it as a free action on its next turn.  
 **Immunity to Temporal Magic (Ex)** Time flayers are immune to all time-related spells and effects (including time stop, temporal stasis, and the like).  
 **Reality Bend (Su)** As a free action, a time flayer can fold the dimensional space surrounding it so its true location is hard to discern. Attackers have a 50% miss chance each time they attack with melee or ranged weapons. This is similar to the miss chance granted by a displacement spell. *See invisibility* does not reveal the creature’s location, but true seeing does.  
 **Temporal Displacement (Su)** As a melee touch attack, a time flayer can send a creature a few seconds into the future. A DC 19 Fortitude save negates. The save is Constitution-based.
